title: Account preferences: notification toggles, language & time zone, danger zone — Driftwood
notes: v1 is a server-rendered settings page (semantic BEM-ish classes, Rails check_box hidden inputs, a notification table with Email/Push columns, a 'Danger zone' section). v2 is a Tailwind UI rewrite: the settings sidebar becomes a horizontal secondary nav (reordered, 'Billing & plan' -> 'Plans & billing'), 'Language & region' now comes before 'Notifications', the notification table becomes a list of Headless UI role=switch buttons with rows reordered and columns Push/Email/In-app, the time-zone select gains optgroups, and the danger zone moves into a <dw-danger-zone> declarative shadow root. Decoys: a portal-rendered confirmation dialog with its own 'Delete account' button placed before the app root, a user menu with another 'Plans & billing' link, a 'Push' switch on every row and a sticky 'You have unsaved changes' bar with a second 'Save changes' button.

targets.description: 'Delete account' button in the danger zone
'Save preferences' submit button of the preferences form
'Billing & plan' link in the settings navigation
